source.license: CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0; see dataset page and original-source conditions
source.use: Local non-commercial research pilot; media and annotations not redistributed.
source.source_encoding: Official compressed raw MP4, not original benchmark JPEGs

dense_video.tracker: Roboflow BoTSORTTracker 2.6.1 defaults except frame_rate=25; no ReID

evaluator.protocol: MOT15, pedestrian, CLEAR IoU=0.5, Identity and HOTA; one training sequence only, no leaderboard submission
evaluator.coordinates: Prediction x/y shifted from zero-based detector pixels to one-based MOT pixels.

dense_video.latency_scope: association step including PNG/IPC for worker; detector/video decoding and worker startup excluded
dense_video.timing_limit: Single local run, no warm-up/repetition or real-time performance acceptance; not a detector throughput result.

real_session.depth_device: Previously verified CUDA / RTX 4090 saved bundles
real_session.depth_units: relative / virtual display depth; not meters
real_session.metric_scope: Separate experimental 24-frame class-aware IoU diagnostic; not TrackEval. GT has no manual visibility/scenario audit.

contract_checks: Subprocess version handshake and isolated imports
Original detection-index mapping, including duplicate boxes
Bounded invalid-response, timeout, exit and dependency failures
API backend dispatch and rejection of request-supplied executable fields
limitations: One short compressed MOT15 training clip; not original benchmark JPEGs or a held-out multi-scene result.
Manual Sessions use fixed 30-Hz steps; real capture gaps are not modelled.
No ReID, identity inference, world trajectory, calibrated metric 3D or speed.
Physical RTSP, scenario/visibility audit, Windows real-model plus worker, endurance and real-time performance remain pending.
public_scope: Aggregate evidence and source/configuration identifiers only; media, GT, per-frame IDs/boxes, sessions, weights, logs, executable paths and private settings remain local.

application_checks.browser_saved_session_segment_worker: PASS, 12 frames; backend selection and English/Traditional Chinese report rendering
